note: Evidence tier of each method version that produces scores, valuations or picks (docs/STRATEGY_V2.md, Part 3.4). Only E3 and above may drive rankings or sizing. Changing a tier needs committed evidence; raising one above E2 needs a passed pre-registered out-of-sample test.

tiers.E3: Passed a pre-registered out-of-sample test with costs and deflated Sharpe, in the relevant size band
tiers.E4: E3 plus at least 24 months of consistent prospective evidence

screen-1.0.evidence: Pre-registered backtest failed (mean IC +0.077, t = 1.92 vs bar 2.0); no evidence among companies over $10bn (IC t = 0.6) or in technology. equity/research/audit_2026-10-14/

val-1.0.evidence: Untested. Growth caps (15% base, 20% bull) and a 3-year average FCF base rate most large companies as 50-90% overvalued by construction (validation of 2026-10-14).
val-1.0.allowed_use: descriptive only; never a buy or sell signal

paper-1.0.evidence: Forward test of screen-1.0, started 2026-10-14. Statistically uninformative for years (STRATEGY_V2 Part 2.4).
paper-1.0.allowed_use: prospective record of screen-1.0; not advice
